text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock 206S-E11SBR Heavy Duty Sliding Bolt Padlock

MUL-T-LOCK Heavy duty 7/16" diameter sliding bolt padlock. Sliding bolt type padlocks offer superior shackle protection over normal padlocks because of less exposed area to cut. All E-Series padlocks are made of Boron Alloy, and can withstand the most determined attempts of physical abuse. When looking for the Ultimate in High Security Padlock Protection, MUL-T-LOCK'S E-Series line of slide bolt padlocks is your answer.

MUL-T-LOCK padlocks are designed to provide high security door protection with patented key control. The Key Card owner is the only person allowed to have the keys duplicated. Remove the worry about anyone making duplicates of your keys.

Supplied standard with 1 owner key card per key combination and 2 keys per lock cylinder.

Features for Mul-T-Lock E11SBR Heavy Duty Sliding Bolt Padlock

  • Hardened Boron Alloy 7/16" Diameter Locking Bolt
  • Hardened Boron Alloy Body
  • Drill and Pick Resistant Cylinder
  • Bump Proof Design
  • Mul-T-Lock 206S Security Keyway
  • MUL-T-LOCK's Patented Interactive Key Control System
  • Limited Lifetime Mechanical Warranty

Features for Mul-T-Lock E11SBR Heavy Duty Sliding Bolt Padlock

  • Bolt (Shackle) Diameter: 7/16" (11mm)
  • Total Height: 2-7/16" (62mm)
  • Total Width: 3" (77mm)
  • Total Thickness: 1-11/32" (34mm)
  • Clearance: 1-1/8" (28mm)
  • Supplied with 2 Keys per Lock
  • MUL-T-LOCK E11SBR Padlock Specifications Diagram (PDF)

If ordering multiple locks you can have them Key Alike (use the same key) or Keyed Different (different keys for each lock). You can also order Extra Keys Cut below if more than the standard 2 keys are required.

** This item is being discontinued. Very limited quantities available.
